newsitem.title: USA: Metromail unit in pact with Sprint.
newsitem.headline: Metromail unit in pact with Sprint.

text.p: Metromail Corp said Wednesday its On-Line Services division will provide national directory assistance services to a division of Sprint Corp.
The agreement will allow Sprint Communications Co to offer branded national directory assistance to its long distance and local telephone customers, Metromail said.
Financial terms of the agreement were not announced.
Metromail provides database marketing software and related services.
Its shares were up 1/2 Wednesday at 17-1/2.
